questions.question: What does Microsoft Entra B2B provide?

options.label: Microsoft Entra B2B allows you to manage your customers' identities. It provides access to applications and resources.
Microsoft Entra B2B allows you to let your users access virtual machines by using their company Microsoft Entra credentials.
Microsoft Entra B2B allows you to invite external users to your tenant so that your staff can collaborate with them.

questions.question: What does Microsoft Entra application proxy do?

options.label: You use it to identify applications in your instance of Microsoft Entra ID.
You use it to add on-premises applications to your instance of Microsoft Entra ID.
You use it to add Microsoft Entra Gallery applications to your instance of Microsoft Entra ID.
